official_title: To direct the Secretary of Agriculture to establish the Mountain Pine Beetle Response Program under which the Secretary may issue competitive grants for use carrying out emergency mountain pine beetle response projects on National Forest Service lands, and for other purposes.
short_title: Emergency Mountain Pine Beetle Response Act

Emergency Mountain Pine Beetle Response Act
